featured_reviews.review_text:
They have this PG here like dormitory room system.
So 2 options :

4) privacy : {5/10} Depends on people you are sharing room with.

Full AC dormitory.

featured_reviews.name: Adam Birchfield
featured_reviews.review_text: I stayed in 11 hostels in India and this one was the worst, at least for the "private" room. The staff had no Idea what was going on or where anything was. Over an hour after arriving we were still waiting for a key and the WiFi password. WiFi only worked for a few hrs. The sheets were dirty, the walls of the room didn't even reach the ceiling so you could hear everything. It was a double private room with a bunk bed. The bed had shards of metal sticking out of it and I hit my head. The light for the room was shared with a different room and the switch was in that room. There were no curtains on the windows that looked at at a bright and busy market. The staff did bring something to cover the window when I asked. The door for the bathroom didn't latch or have a handle. Moved to a different hostel the next day.

featured_reviews.name: Soham Parekh
featured_reviews.review_text: Stayed here for one night. Honestly, you have to enter the room, forget where you are, and sleep it off. Service is bad, I saw rats on the second floor, toilets are horrible. It's viable only if you plan to stay one night and manage to sleep off, otherwise do not choose this place.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently stayed at a hostel in Bandra and had a fantastic experience! The hostel was clean, comfortable, and conveniently located. The staff were friendly and helpful, and the atmosphere was lively and social.

The rooms were well-maintained and had all the necessary amenities. The common areas were spacious and perfect for meeting fellow travelers.

Bandra is a great location, with plenty of restaurants, cafes, and shops nearby. The hostel is also close to public transportation, making it easy to get around the city.

Overall, I would highly recommend this hostel to anyone looking for a comfortable and affordable place to stay in Bandra. Great value for money!

featured_reviews.name: Udita Jangid
featured_reviews.review_text: Over all the experience was really good, It was my first time in the hostel in mumbai. It genuinely felt like home. featured_reviews.review_text: Great value for money option with amazing location. The host is very helpful and friendly. They provide complimentary breakfast too. At a price point of less than ₹1000/Night at location, it's unbeatable. Would definitely recommend.

featured_reviews.name: Farhat Khan
featured_reviews.review_text: I had an incredible experience during my stay at this hostel. The rooms were clean, comfortable, and well-maintained, offering everything I needed to relax. The common area was vibrant and well-designed, making it easy to meet other travelers. The location is perfect, with easy access to public transport and popular spots in the city. Whether you’re looking to explore or just unwind, this hostel is an ideal choice.

featured_reviews.name: kasturi zade
featured_reviews.review_text: Hospitality at its best, vibes so good that you don’t wanna leave. Very clean and hygienic. The staff is very warm. Located at a prestige area of Mumbai. Very safe for women. It’s a must visit if you plan to stay in town.

featured_reviews.name: Lucas
featured_reviews.review_text:
We only stayed for one night, because we didn't get much sleep there.

There are no signs at the entry gate and also no signs on the door on the 1st floor.

The aircondition and ventilators in our room were extremely load and running the entire night because otherwise it would have been to warm.
The sound level was louder than in an airplane.

The hostel consists of a small flat only with 3 rooms, a commong room + kitchen. Therefore we felt a bit constricted inside, air quality was also very bad in the common area.

There were mostly Indian people who live there long term for working. Only few other western tourists.

The Hostel owner was very friendly though. Breakfast was also fine and complementory.

featured_reviews.review_text: I had an amazing stay at a hostel that truly stood out for its vibrant atmosphere and thoughtful amenities. The location was perfect, just steps from the city center, making it easy to explore nearby attractions. The dorms were spotlessly clean, with comfy beds featuring privacy curtains and individual lockers for security. The common area was spacious and cozy, with a fully equipped kitchen that made cooking a breeze. The staff were incredibly friendly, organizing daily events like walking tours and game nights, which helped me connect with other travelers. featured_reviews.review_text: The value of this hostel for its price is great; the atmosphere is really nice, the staff is super friendly, lots of nice people who are in to spending activities together (both tourists and locals), and the location of the hostel is simply superb. Also you can use the opportunity to get your laundry done. Lots of people also tend to stay a little longer in this hostel than their initial booking, which is also a good sign.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Room quality is clean and well-maintained. 800Rs per day per head.
Crowd that comes here also is decent, but we were falsely led to believe that there is one restroom between 4 beds which was actually one for 15/16 beds.
There is only one common bathroom among 16 people. Lighting of the place is little on the darker side, and air ventilation also is average.
Only selling point seems to be walkable distance to Station, and close proximity to Bandstand.
Would definitely not be my first stay choice.

featured_reviews.review_text: Sorry but contrary to the other reviews i have to say that our stay at this hostel was not the most welcoming. For half the price it would be a good value for money. featured_reviews.name: Anurag Shastry
featured_reviews.review_text:
1. It's located at one of the best locations in Mumbai. Bandra (W)
2. You can enter and exit at any time you want.
3. The owner and employees are very friendly and support you in case you have any discomforts.
4. The common hall is really spacious and clean. A good spot to sit and watch TV or do whatever you want to.
5. The kitchen is available at all times. Cook your own food if you want to or request one of the employees.
6. The bathroom is clean and well maintained.
7. The beds are comfortable enough for a good night's sleep.
8. A lot of amenities around the hostel.
9. Secured place - as it is beside the Bandra Police Station.
10. A safe place for women as well.
11. Bandra local railway station is 200 meters from the hostel.

Absolutely Horrible Experience – Avoid at All Costs!

I had one of the worst stays of my life at Solo Backpackers. The place is infested with rats – yes, actual rats running around in the rooms. Totally unacceptable and disgusting.

There is only one washroom for over 50 people, which is just insane. Long queues, no cleanliness, and constant water issues. Hygiene is clearly not a priority here.

They shut the lift after 11 PM and expect guests to climb 7 floors – with luggage, mind you. If you’re tired or even remotely have mobility issues, forget it. You’re on your own.

What’s worse is the attitude of the owners and staff. Completely careless and rude. A staff member named Ansari was especially horrible – he doesn’t know how to speak to guests and has zero hospitality skills. He was arrogant, unhelpful, and plain disrespectful.

This place should not even be in the hospitality business. Do yourself a favor and stay anywhere else.

featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐ 5 Stars of Disgrace – Seva Niketan

This is by far the worst place I have ever stayed. The staff openly smoke, drink, and use weed in areas where they know there are no cameras. Rooms are never cleaned — they’re filthy, unhygienic, and the beds are infested with bed bugs.

The lady at the front desk seems more interested in picking fights than helping guests. They allow cops and GST officers to walk in at any hour, but paying guests are locked out if they return late. Even after taking your money, they won’t open the gate or show basic courtesy.

The bathrooms are always clogged and dirty, and the canteen is outright disgusting — you can see rats running around the kitchen. It’s shocking that a place run under Christian management treats guests with such disrespect and neglect.

To make things worse, they refuse to provide any proper proof of payment — no bills, no receipts, nothing.

A completely mismanaged, unhygienic, and unsafe place. Stay away.

featured_reviews.name: BubbleAisle
featured_reviews.review_text:
I usually don’t leave reviews, but I feel compelled to share my disappointing experience. First off, the customer service was incredibly lacking. The staff seemed uninterested and unhelpful, which made the entire experience feel very uncomfortable. I waited much longer than expected for my order, and when it finally arrived, it was cold and not at all what I had asked for.

The ambiance was nothing to write home about either. The place was poorly lit, and the decor felt outdated and drab. To make matters worse, the bathroom was dirty, and the overall cleanliness of the restaurant was far below acceptable standards.

I also found the pricing to be absurd for the quality of food and service I received. It’s clear that this place is not focused on its customers, and I won’t be returning. Definitely not worth the hype.
